hostname rt-u01
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description to sample upstream
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description sample lan
 ip address 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.0
 ip ospf 1 area 0
 ip ospf priority 1
 ip ospf hello-interval 10
 ip ospf dead-interval 40
 no shutdown
!
interface Loopback0
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.255
 no shutdown
!
router ospf 1
 router-id 192.0.2.1
 distance ospf intra-area 100 inter-area 105 external 120
 distribute-list prefix pl-u-ospf in
 area 1 virtual-link 192.0.2.9 hello-interval 5 dead-interval 20
 default-information originate always metric 50 metric-type 1
 no passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/1
!
router bgp 64496
 bgp router-id 192.0.2.1
 timers bgp 20 60
 distance bgp 30 190 200
 neighbor 192.0.2.2 remote-as 64496
 neighbor 192.0.2.2 update-source Loopback0
 neighbor 192.0.2.2 next-hop-self
 neighbor 192.0.2.2 timers 10 30
 neighbor 192.0.2.2 route-reflector-client
 neighbor 192.0.2.3 remote-as 64496
 neighbor 192.0.2.3 update-source Loopback0
 neighbor 192.0.2.3 next-hop-self
 neighbor 192.0.2.3 timers 10 30
 neighbor 192.0.2.3 route-reflector-client
 neighbor 203.0.113.2 remote-as 64497
 neighbor 203.0.113.2 route-map rm-u-out out
 neighbor 203.0.113.2 default-originate
 neighbor 203.0.113.2 advertisement-interval 15
 network 198.51.100.0 mask 255.255.255.0
 aggregate-address 198.51.100.0 255.255.254.0 summary-only
!
ip prefix-list pl-u-ospf seq 5 permit 198.51.100.0/24 le 28
!
ip community-list standard CD-rm-u-out-10 permit 64497:100
ip community-list standard CD-rm-u-out-10 permit 64497:200
!
route-map rm-u-out permit 10
 set comm-list CD-rm-u-out-10 delete
!
end
